titel: Reinstate a Schedule F in the excepted service
grundlage: The chapter recounts Executive Order 13957 and calls for career positions of a policy-determining character to be moved into a new Schedule F.

titel: Bring the central personnel agencies under closer presidential control
grundlage: Treats OPM, MSPB, FLRA and the Office of Special Counsel as instruments of presidential management of the bureaucracy.

titel: Renegotiate federal collective bargaining agreements
grundlage: Invokes Executive Order 13836 and urges agencies to renegotiate union agreements.

titel: Use OMB as the central instrument of presidential control
grundlage: The chapter on the Executive Office of the President treats OMB as the lever for directing the agencies.

titel: Increase the number and reach of political appointees
grundlage: Calls for early planning of the political workforce, naming Schedule F as an example.

titel: Relocate agency functions out of Washington
grundlage: Argues for moving parts of the bureaucracy away from the capital region.

titel: Reduce the number of general officers
grundlage: States that rank creep is pervasive and calls for a reduction.

titel: Eliminate what the chapter calls politicization of the armed forces
grundlage: Calls for ending politicization and restoring what it terms standards of lethality.

titel: Increase allied conventional defence burden-sharing
grundlage: Sets increased allied burden-sharing as a priority.

titel: Reorganise the Department of State around presidential priorities
grundlage: Proposes restructuring the department and its personnel practices.

titel: Restructure the Agency for International Development
grundlage: Proposes a wholesale reorientation of the agency, including its personnel system.

titel: Restructure oversight of the intelligence community
grundlage: Proposes changes to the ODNI and to oversight arrangements.

titel: End what the chapter calls parole abuse by legislating parole standards
grundlage: Calls for statutory parole standards.

titel: Eliminate the T and U visa categories
grundlage: States that victimisation should not be a basis for an immigration benefit.

titel: Make full use of expedited removal authority
grundlage: Urges ICE to use existing expedited removal authority to its full statutory extent.

titel: Withdraw and reissue the previous administration's immigration regulations
grundlage: Lists regulatory areas to be withdrawn and reissued.

titel: Restructure the Department of Homeland Security
grundlage: Proposes a reorganisation of the department and its components.

titel: Remove climate considerations from LNG export approvals
grundlage: Calls for eliminating what it terms political and climate-change interference in DOE approvals of liquefied natural gas exports.

titel: Eliminate the Department of Energy's applied research programmes
grundlage: Calls for eliminating applied programmes and ending funding for commercial technology and deployment.

titel: Narrow or revoke California's Clean Air Act waiver
grundlage: Argues the waiver applies only to California-specific issues, not to global ones; the transport chapter calls for revocation.

titel: Repeal the AIM Act implementing regulations
grundlage: Calls the implementing regulations unnecessarily stringent and costly.

titel: Restore the Once-In, Always-In position on major sources
grundlage: Calls for restoring the earlier position that major sources may convert to area sources.

titel: Reopen the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska to leasing
grundlage: Calls for reinstating the earlier plan for opening most of the reserve.

titel: Reinstate the 2020 Arctic National Wildlife Refuge environmental impact statement
grundlage: Calls for reinstatement by secretarial order and for lifting the suspension of leases.

titel: Rescind the previous administration's Interior rules
grundlage: Lists rules to be rescinded and earlier rules to be reinstated.

titel: Reinstate the earlier safety protocols for mifepristone
grundlage: Calls for reinstating protocols largely removed in 2016 and applying them to generics.

titel: End NIH research using tissue from abortions
grundlage: Calls for ending intramural projects using such tissue and human embryonic stem cell research.

titel: Restore conscience and religious exemption enforcement at HHS
grundlage: Calls for rescinding efforts to curtail the Office for Civil Rights' authority in this area.

titel: Reorganise the Department of Health and Human Services
grundlage: Proposes structural change across the department's operating divisions.

titel: Eliminate the Head Start programme
grundlage: States plainly that the programme should be eliminated.

titel: Restructure Medicaid financing and eligibility
grundlage: Proposes changes to financing arrangements and eligibility rules.

titel: Withdraw federal support for gender-transition care for minors
grundlage: Proposes removing federal support and related regulatory requirements.

titel: Wind down the Department of Education and disperse its functions
grundlage: The chapter proposes transferring programmes to other departments and returning responsibility to the states.

titel: Transfer Title I, Part A out of the Department of Education
grundlage: Names Title I, Part A for transfer and proposes returning revenue responsibility to the states over ten years.

titel: Rescind the Title IX regulations and the definition of sex they use
grundlage: Calls for barring enforcement of the regulations and for reversing the redefinition of sex across departments.

titel: Move the Office for Civil Rights to the Department of Justice
grundlage: Proposes the transfer while retaining federal civil rights enforcement.

titel: Advance education choice, including for federally connected children
grundlage: Frames education freedom as the central reform and names federally connected children specifically.

titel: Restructure the federal student loan portfolio
grundlage: Proposes changes to federal lending and to loan forgiveness arrangements.

titel: Move Impact Aid programmes to Defence or Interior
grundlage: Names DoDEA and the Department of the Interior as recipients.

titel: Adopt the fair trade position on tariffs and reciprocity
grundlage: Set out by Peter Navarro. The same chapter carries the opposing free trade case by Kent Lassman at page 796; the document does not settle between them.

titel: Adopt the free trade position on tariffs and reciprocity
grundlage: Set out by Kent Lassman as the counter-position to the fair trade case at page 765. Tracking both makes the document's internal disagreement visible.

titel: Bar Chinese state-owned enterprises from federal procurement
grundlage: One of a series of China-related prohibitions.

titel: Restrict Chinese investment in high-technology industries
grundlage: Proposes prohibiting such investment.

titel: Abolish the Export–Import Bank
grundlage: Argued by Veronique de Rugy. The same chapter carries Jennifer Hazelton's case for retaining the bank at page 724.

titel: Retain the Export–Import Bank
grundlage: Argued by Jennifer Hazelton against the abolition case at page 717.

titel: Remove full employment from the Federal Reserve's mandate
grundlage: Calls for a single mandate focused on price stability.

titel: Abolish or restructure the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
grundlage: Set out in the financial regulatory chapter.

titel: Bar SEC requirements for social, political or human capital disclosure
grundlage: Proposes prohibiting such disclosure requirements.

titel: Defund the Corporation for Public Broadcasting
grundlage: Set out in the media agencies chapter.

titel: Restructure the U.S. Agency for Global Media
grundlage: Proposes reorienting the agency's mission and personnel.

titel: Eliminate the immunities courts have added to Section 230
grundlage: Proposes narrowing the statutory immunity as courts have construed it.

titel: Change enforcement practice at the Federal Election Commission
grundlage: Set out in the elections chapter.

titel: Eliminate EEO-1 employment data collection
grundlage: Calls for ending the collection of EEO-1 data.

titel: Eliminate disparate impact as a theory of discrimination
grundlage: Calls for eliminating disparate impact liability under Title VII and other laws.

titel: Eliminate the Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs
grundlage: Calls for eliminating the office, which enforces Executive Order 11246.

titel: Restrict the application of Bostock
grundlage: Calls for restricting how the decision's reading of sex discrimination is applied.

titel: Repeal the federal sugar programme
grundlage: Argues the federal government should not be in central planning.

titel: Move USDA food and nutrition programmes to HHS
grundlage: Proposes the transfer.

titel: Rescind VA clinical policy directives and delegations of authority
grundlage: Calls for rescinding directives and all delegations promulgated under the prior administration.

titel: Reduce fuel economy standards
grundlage: Proposes returning to lower average fuel economy levels.
